value.rationale: The emerging 2026 phase-lag ring basin problem asks which initial data approach synchronization or do not. The prior 2018 skew-coupled analysis gives only a qualitative heteroclinic surface. The explicit sharp rho_c and saddle coordinates locate its intersection with a physically specified balanced family for all phase lags 0<alpha<pi/2 and offer a fully analyzable benchmark for basin-boundary computations. This is a structural, nontrivial separatrix threshold rather than a routine parameter substitution.
